title: First day of trading in Carasent AB (publ) on Nasdaq Stockholm
content:
Carasent completed a cross-border merger on December 5, 2024, transitioning from Oslo Børs to Nasdaq Stockholm. The company's shareholders exchanged their shares in Carasent ASA one-for-one for shares in Carasent AB (publ), with trading commencing December 9, 2024.

Key Points:
- The merger finalized a relisting strategy, with Carasent ASA delisting from Oslo Børs
- Board members and management received shares as part of the listing process
- The company provides cloud based EHR solutions, with Webdoc as the leading platform, and a broad ecosystem of platform services
- Solutions include patient communication and business intelligence capabilities
